config.inner_particle_reduction: negative log arithmetic mean of 100 likelihood products, separately per bank
config.outer_reduction: arithmetic bank mean, then independent-group statistics

reference.V_center: fixed old truth PMF spin marginal means and true spin covariances; candidate pair moment by GH

config.conditional_scope: Intervals condition on frozen old 16 data sets, all candidates, and qualified reference P weights; development t approximation, not new training-population inference.

scope: All means are total mathematical float64 scores. Each bank has one inner K100 arithmetic likelihood average before log; outer bank averages are separate. No weighted population/data statistics or new tests are computed in this runner. Numerical failures are retained without expanding or retrying the scientific budget.
